Rope Guided Crossing.name: Rope Guided Crossing
Rope Guided Crossing.description: The user touches their own body with all five pads and floats, then pulls along an already secured rope to cross a fifteen-meter gap this turn. The user releases only above a safe landing. This requires a rope and an anchor that holds their weight when gravity returns; self-floating causes nausea, and the Quirk supplies no thrust if the rope slips. Strain: moderate.
